name: John Pork
blurb: A pig-headed virtual influencer whose "John Pork is calling" edit went viral in 2023
title: John Pork Meme: Meaning, Origin & "John Pork Is Calling"
description: John Pork is a pig-headed virtual influencer on Instagram since 2018; the "John Pork is calling" TikTok edit went viral in March 2023.
answer: John Pork is a fictional virtual influencer: a man with a realistic pig's head, posting selfies like an ordinary Instagram user since September 2018. He became a TikTok meme in March 2023, when an edit put his selfie on an incoming phone call screen, "John Pork is calling", with the joke being whether you would answer. A fake "John Pork is dead" video days later made him even more famous.

body: John Pork's account presents him as a normal guy who travels, takes selfies and dances, except his head is a lifelike pink pig's head on a human body. The images are digitally created; who runs the account has never been made public. The humour is the deadpan treatment: the pig man is never explained.

body.note: The best-known format is the call screen: John Pork's photo, his name, and "Accept" / "Decline" buttons, with a ringtone. Comments argue about whether to pick up.

head: Date
Event
rows: First Instagram post on @john.pork: a selfie at Doune Castle in Scotland.
A dancing video marks his "return"; John Pork starts appearing in Reddit memes.
A TikTok "John Pork is calling" edit made with a CapCut template gets about 2.7 million views in three days.
A TikTok video claiming John Pork had died reaches about 6 million views in three days, spreading the meme further.

ul: Posting the call screen with captions like "POV: John Pork is calling at 3 a.m." and asking "accept or decline?"
"Don't answer" horror jokes, treating a call from John Pork as an omen.
Joke memorials and "RIP John Pork" posts riffing on the death hoax.
Replying "decline" or "I'm not picking up" under any post that shows the call screen.

body: John Pork peaked on TikTok in spring 2023 and is now a recognisable piece of Gen Alpha brainrot, often grouped with Skibidi Toilet and Smurf Cat. He is not dead: the death video was a hoax, and the character still exists online.

faq.q: Is John Pork a real person?
faq.a: No. He is a digitally created pig-headed character run as a virtual influencer; the person behind the account is not publicly known.
No. A March 2023 TikTok claiming he died was a joke that helped the meme spread.

faq.q: What does "John Pork is calling" mean?
faq.a: It is an edit showing an incoming call from John Pork. The joke is the absurd idea of a pig man calling you, and whether you would answer.
